result.answer:
按已交付商品成交额（不含运费，BRL，2016–2018历史快照），health_beauty（健康美容）卖得最好，约123.3万；但按订单量，bed_bath_table（床品浴室）最多，约9272单。两种“最好”口径不同，结论不同。

关键发现
• 成交额口径：health_beauty 约123.3万居首，watches_gifts 约116.6万第二，bed_bath_table 约102.3万第三[1]。
• 订单量口径：bed_bath_table 约9272单第一，health_beauty 约8647单第二；其客单价约110.4，低于health_beauty的约142.6[2]。
• 月度走势显示前5品类排名逐月变化，health_beauty并非每月第一，领先地位不稳定[3]。
• 交付表现表只覆盖交付天数最长的15个品类，未包含上述头部品类，无法据此比较它们的交付表现[4]。

建议行动
• 若目标是成交额，可优先测试health_beauty的曝光与转化优化；证据是它成交额居首[1]。下一步按品类跟踪月度成交额与订单量，确认领先是否持续。
• 若目标是订单量，可测试bed_bath_table的复购与关联购买；证据是它订单量第一但客单价较低[2]。下一步测量复购率与客单价变化。
• 先统一“卖得最好”的口径（成交额还是订单量）再决策；证据是两种口径给出不同冠军[1][2]。下一步明确指标定义并复核。

口径与局限
• GMV是商品成交额，不等于平台收入或利润；无可靠退款、成本、投放数据，无法计算净收入、利润或ROI。
• 历史Olist快照（BRL，2016–2018），边界月份可能不完整，不能当作当前业务现状。
• 第3步仅返回前30行样本，第4步只覆盖交付天数最长的15个品类，均不能支持全量或因果结论。

• “卖得最好”是指成交额、订单量还是件数？
• 需要限定时间范围或品类范围吗？
• 是否需要按卖家或地区进一步拆分？

AOV / 客单价 = delivered GMV / delivered order count.
Cancellation rate / 取消率 = canceled orders / all orders by purchase date.
On-time rate / 准时交付率 = on_time true / delivered orders with non-null on_time.
Delivery days / 交付天数 = purchase-to-delivery calendar day difference, only delivered orders with valid timestamps.
GMV is not platform revenue or profit.
Unqualified revenue/net revenue requires clarification.

result.answer:
基于这份2016–2018年巴西电商历史快照（BRL，已交付口径），成交额最高的是健康美容，订单量最多的是床品家纺；两者都值得优先经营，但证据只到“卖得多”，不能说明赚钱或该加投入。

关键发现
• 按已交付商品成交额（不含运费）排名，健康美容第一（约123.3万BRL、8647单），手表礼品第二（约116.6万、5495单），床品家纺第三（约102.3万、9272单）[1]。
• 按订单量排名，床品家纺第一（9272单），健康美容第二（8647单）；手表礼品订单较少但品类客单价最高（约212.2 BRL/单），说明“卖得多”和“单笔大”是两回事[2]。
• 前5品类的月度成交额显示领先地位随时间变化，不是某一个月单独撑起；但返回表只展示了部分月份行，不能据此判断全期冠军[3]。
• 交付表现表按平均交付天数降序取前15，办公家具最长（约20.6天、准时率91.9%）；该表未覆盖上述头部品类，因此不能推断它们的交付风险[4]。

business_context.fields: fct_orders: one row per order. purchased_at is purchase time; delivered_at is actual delivery. raw amounts are strings; use TRY_CAST(... AS DECIMAL(18,2)). customer_unique_id identifies returning buyers; customer_id identifies order-specific customer records. 原始金额为文本，先转DECIMAL；复购用customer_unique_id。
business_context.metrics: Delivered GMV / 已交付商品成交额 = SUM(fct_orders.item_amount) WHERE order_status=delivered, excluding freight, grouped by purchase date. AOV / 客单价 = delivered GMV / delivered order count. Cancellation rate / 取消率 = canceled orders / all orders by purchase date. result.answer:
There is no single 'best seller' — it depends on the measure. By delivered goods value (GMV, the money from delivered items, excluding freight), health_beauty leads at about 1,233,132 BRL [1]. By units sold, bed_bath_table leads with 10,953 items [2]. Both are historical Olist snapshot figures in BRL (2016–2018).

Findings
• GMV leader: health_beauty, ~1,233,132 BRL across 8,647 delivered orders and 9,465 units [1].
• Unit leader: bed_bath_table, 10,953 units across 9,272 delivered orders [2]; it ranks third by GMV (~1,023,435 BRL) [1].
• watches_gifts is second by GMV (~1,166,177 BRL) but only seventh by units (5,859) [1][2], suggesting higher value per item — though prices cannot be confirmed from this ranking.
• Monthly GMV for the top 5 categories is only partially shown (30 of 106 rows) [3], so month-to-month leadership shifts cannot be reliably judged.

Suggested actions
• If the goal is revenue, prioritise health_beauty and watches_gifts; if the goal is volume/logistics, prioritise bed_bath_table. Why: the two measures disagree [1][2]. Measure next: delivered GMV and units per category over a full period.
• Test whether high-AOV niches (e.g. computers, ~1,235.50 BRL per order, 177 orders) are worth targeted attention. Why: they show high value per order but low volume [4]. Measure next: order count and GMV trend for these niches.
• Re-run the monthly trend query without the 30-row display cap before drawing any seasonal conclusion. Why: the current monthly view is incomplete [3]. Measure next: full monthly GMV per top category.

Limitations
• GMV is not profit or net revenue; no refund, cost or ad-spend data exists, so profitability cannot be assessed.
• The monthly trend table is truncated to 30 of 106 rows [3]; boundary months may be partial.
• Rankings are historical (2016–2018) and reflect only delivered orders; they do not prove causes of sales.

AOV / 客单价 = delivered GMV / delivered order count.
Cancellation rate / 取消率 = canceled orders / all orders by purchase date.
On-time rate / 准时交付率 = on_time true / delivered orders with non-null on_time.
Delivery days / 交付天数 = purchase-to-delivery calendar day difference, only delivered orders with valid timestamps.

reference_evidence.answer:
There is no single 'best seller' — it depends on the measure. By delivered goods value (GMV, the money from delivered items, excluding freight), health_beauty leads at about 1,233,132 BRL [1]. By units sold, bed_bath_table leads with 10,953 items [2]. Both are historical Olist snapshot figures in BRL (2016–2018).

Findings
• GMV leader: health_beauty, ~1,233,132 BRL across 8,647 delivered orders and 9,465 units [1].
• Unit leader: bed_bath_table, 10,953 units across 9,272 delivered orders [2]; it ranks third by GMV (~1,023,435 BRL) [1].
• watches_gifts is second by GMV (~1,166,177 BRL) but only seventh by units (5,859) [1][2], suggesting higher value per item — though prices cannot be confirmed from this ranking.
• Monthly GMV for the top 5 categories is only partially shown (30 of 106 rows) [3], so month-to-month leadership shifts cannot be reliably judged.

Suggested actions
• If the goal is revenue, prioritise health_beauty and watches_gifts; if the goal is volume/logistics, prioritise bed_bath_table. Why: the two measures disagree [1][2]. Measure next: delivered GMV and units per category over a full period.
• Test whether high-AOV niches (e.g. computers, ~1,235.50 BRL per order, 177 orders) are worth targeted attention. Why: they show high value per order but low volume [4]. Measure next: order count and GMV trend for these niches.
• Re-run the monthly trend query without the 30-row display cap before drawing any seasonal conclusion. Why: the current monthly view is incomplete [3]. Measure next: full monthly GMV per top category.

Limitations
• GMV is not profit or net revenue; no refund, cost or ad-spend data exists, so profitability cannot be assessed.
• The monthly trend table is truncated to 30 of 106 rows [3]; boundary months may be partial.
• Rankings are historical (2016–2018) and reflect only delivered orders; they do not prove causes of sales.

business_context.metrics: Delivered GMV / 已交付商品成交额 = SUM(fct_orders.item_amount) WHERE order_status=delivered, excluding freight, grouped by purchase date. AOV / 客单价 = delivered GMV / delivered order count. Cancellation rate / 取消率 = canceled orders / all orders by purchase date. On-time rate / 准时交付率 = on_time true / delivered orders with non-null on_time. Delivery days / 交付天数 = purchase-to-delivery calendar day difference, only delivered orders with valid timestamps. GMV is not platform revenue or profit. Unqualified revenue/net revenue requires clarification.
